style.vernacular: Rebuilt-historic and prewar Warsaw: four- to six-storey plastered tenements in pastel ochre, cream, pink and pale green with hip or mansard roofs and cornices; Stalinist socialist-realist blocks in stone and plaster; 1960-85 large-panel housing estates (blokowiska) of grey concrete now often insulated in pastel render with flat roofs; red-brick churches and military buildings; glass office towers in the centre; and suburban or village houses with plastered walls and red or brown ceramic or metal-tile hip roofs among pine and birch.
style.ornament: Cornices, window surrounds and rusticated ground floors on tenements; Baroque and neoclassical palace details in pale plaster with white trim; socialist-realist pilasters, colonnades and spires; sgraffito and stripped-classical facades; pastel-painted panel-block insulation in geometric colour blocks; brick Gothic-revival and modern parish churches.
